title: [EPIC] Book/reading mode — Bookwyrm replacement
description: Add federated book tracking and reviews to all three servers. Book database, reading shelves (to-read, reading, read), reviews, ratings. Federates with existing Bookwyrm instances. Uses AP for reviews (as Article objects) and reading status (as custom activities). Broadside: publisher book announcements. Smallhold: personal reading log. Gaja: multi-tenant book community.
